top_signals.title: Asian Ports Snarled as El Niño Fuels Busy Typhoon Season
top_signals.summary: An unusually active typhoon season is disrupting shipping operations across Asia, with Shanghai particularly hard hit by snarled traffic and vessel delays.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: John Lewis Loss Widens as Turnaround Hit by Higher Costs
top_signals.summary: John Lewis Partnership Plc’s loss widened in the first half due to higher costs and shoppers reining in spending, undermining the British department store chain’s turnaround bid.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Trezor warns users of email provider breach, phishing attacks
top_signals.summary: Trezor warned customers on Wednesday that threat actors who breached its third-party email provider are targeting them in phishing attacks. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FirstRand Profit Falls 5% as $1.1 Billion Provision Curbs Gains
top_signals.summary: FirstRand Ltd. profit fell for the first time in six years after a £807 million ($1.1 billion) provision for UK clients’ claims over missold car loans at its British motor-finance unit countered growth from loans and fee income.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Bank tests proprietary stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction
top_signals.summary: The pilot moved USBDC between the bank’s North American and European entities on the public Stellar blockchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Why Payment Companies Are Choosing India's GIFT City
top_signals.summary: IFSCA Executive Director Dipesh Shah says GIFT City offers payment companies flexible regulations, streamlined approvals, and greater freedom in cross-border transactions, helping position it as a competitive global financial hub. (Source: Bloomberg)
